summary: "Firefox improved the Web Audio decoder path for real-world audio files, especially FLAC streams with changing per-frame channel counts and Vorbis files whose channel order needs to be corrected. By fixing how multichannel audio is arranged before playback, it avoids odd channel swaps or missing sound when audio is decoded and mixed in the browser. This is especially important for streaming media, music apps, and other web experiences that rely on accurate stereo and surround playback."
